WBPSC Announces 1145 Sub-Surveyor Vacancies: Important Dates, Eligibility, and Application Details

30 Oct 2026, 01:26 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Careers Desk · Source: www.freejobalert.com

Image: www.freejobalert.com — Creative Commons

Key takeawaysThe Public Service Commission, West Bengal (WBPSC) has officially announced Advertisement No. 22/2024 for the recruitment of 1145 Sub-Surveyor posts within the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys, Department of Land & Land Reforms and Refugee Relief & Rehabilitation,

The Public Service Commission, West Bengal (WBPSC) has officially announced Advertisement No. 22/2024 for the recruitment of 1145 Sub-Surveyor posts within the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys, Department of Land & Land Reforms and Refugee Relief & Rehabilitation, Government of West Bengal. The position is permanent, offering prospective candidates stable government employment with standard state pay structures.

Online applications opened on October 20, 2026, and will close on November 9, 2026, at 3:00 PM. Interested applicants must submit their forms exclusively through the official WBPSC website.

Key Dates and Application Timeline

Applicants must complete both registration and fee payment within the stipulated timeframe to be considered for the examination.

  • Online Application Start Date: October 20, 2026
  • Closing Date for Applications and Fee Payment: November 9, 2026 (up to 3:00 PM)
  • One-Time Edit Window: November 11, 2026, to November 16, 2026

An application fee of Rs. 110 plus applicable service charges is required for General and OBC candidates. Candidates belonging to SC and ST categories of West Bengal, as well as Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) with a disability of 40% or higher, are exempt from the fee.

Eligibility Criteria and Qualifications

To meet the basic standards set by the commission, candidates must fulfill specific educational, age, and linguistic requirements by the application closing date.

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the Madhyamik or equivalent examination, along with either a 3-year Diploma in Survey Engineering or an ITI Surveyor certificate backed by required practical experience.
  • Age Limit: Applicants must be between 21 and 45 years of age as of January 1, 2024. Age relaxations apply to eligible reserved categories in accordance with state guidelines.
  • Language Requirement: Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Bengali is mandatory, except for native Nepali speakers who are exempt from this specific test unless otherwise specified.

Selection Procedure

The selection process comprises a multi-stage written examination designed to evaluate candidates across language proficiency, core technical knowledge, and general aptitude.

  • Paper-I: A conventional-type test covering letter writing, report drafting, and grammar in Bengali or Nepali, aligned with the Madhyamik standard. A qualifying threshold of 30% is mandated.
  • Paper-II: An objective-type multiple-choice question (MCQ) examination covering English fundamentals, elementary mathematics, and survey engineering. A negative marking scheme of 0.25 marks applies to incorrect answers.

Final merit lists are determined based on performance in Paper-II, provided candidates clear the qualifying criteria in Paper-I. Document verification follows the written examination phases.

Salary Structure

Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Level-7, carrying a pay scale ranging from Rs. 24,700 to Rs. 63,900 per month, supplemented by admissible allowances determined by the state government.

Practical Implications and Verification Guide

What is Confirmed vs. Unknown

  • Confirmed: The total vacancy count (1145 posts), pay scale (Level-7), application deadlines, basic eligibility criteria, and two-tier written examination format are officially confirmed by the notification.
  • Unknown: Exact dates for the written examination, detailed schedules for document verification, and specific test center allocations have not yet been disclosed by the commission.

How to Verify the Announcement

Readers should independently verify all recruitment guidelines, download the official notification PDF, and submit applications directly through the authorized portal:
